title: Keep contact links readable after tapping
summary: Removed desktop white-hover utilities from contact links and defined contrasting mobile interaction colors.

changes.detail: WhatsApp and email links remain dark green on mobile hover, focus, active and visited states. Desktop retains light text for its dark background.
Improved contact value contrast and weight, added a green tap highlight and stronger pressed-card background and border. Reduced motion disables link transitions.
